}}
{{recipe}}

'''Ka'ak''' (Arabic: كعك), is a biscuit traditionally baked while clinging to the wall of a clay oven, or on the floor of a masonry oven. The dough is enriched with oil, sugar, black cumin, and yeast, and flavored with condiments, such as honey or sugar, and it is basted with egg yolks (as desired). It is eaten extensively throughout the Middle East and Persia.

== Ingredients ==
* ½ [[Cookbook:Cup|cup]] lukewarm water
* ½ [[Cookbook:Cup|cup]] [[cookbook:vegetable oil|vegetable oil]] (preferably [[Cookbook:Rapeseed Oil|canola oil]])
* 100 [[Cookbook:Gram|g]] soft [[cookbook:margarine|margarine]] or [[cookbook:butter|butter]]
* 3 [[Cookbook:Cup|cups]] [[cookbook:flour|wheat flour]]
* 1 [[Cookbook:Tablespoon|tbsp]] [[Cookbook:Baking Powder|baking powder]] or dried [[cookbook:yeast|yeast]] 
* 1 [[Cookbook:Teaspoon|tsp]] [[cookbook:sugar|light brown sugar]]
* 2 [[Cookbook:Teaspoon|tsp]] [[cookbook:salt|salt]]
* 2 [[Cookbook:Tablespoon|tbsp]] [[cookbook:Sesame Seed|sesame seeds]] 
* 1 [[Cookbook:Teaspoon|tsp]] [[Cookbook:Nigella|black cumin]] (''Nigella sativa'') (optional)
* 10 [[Cookbook:Gram|g]] dried [[Cookbook:Marjoram|marjoram]], [[Cookbook:Za'atar|za'atar]] or [[Cookbook:Oregano|oregano]] (optional)
* ¾ [[Cookbook:Teaspoon|tsp]] ground Mahaleb cherry (''Prunus mahaleb'') kernels (optional)
* 2 [[cookbook:egg yolk|egg yolks]] (for basting), beaten

== Procedure ==
# Combine water, oil and soft margarine (or butter) in bowl.
# Mix together flour, baking powder (or dried yeast), brown sugar, salt, and spices.
# Mix dry ingredients with wet ingredients (except egg yolks) until you get a [[Cookbook:Dough|dough]].
# Let dough mixture rest for 30 minutes until it reaches its proper consistency.
# Cut dough into half. Roll each half into a coil with your hands. You should now have 2 pieces.
# Cut each coil in half, and again roll out each coil into a smaller coil with one's hands. You should now have 4 pieces.
# Cut each coil in half, and again roll out each coil into a smaller coil with one's hands. You should now have 8 pieces.
# Cut each coil at angles into 4 equal pieces. You should now have 32 pieces
# Pinch together the ends of each coil so that it forms a ring. Place on a [[Cookbook:Baking Sheet|baking sheet]], and let sit until the dough rises.
# [[Cookbook:Brushing|Brush]] each dough ring with [[Cookbook:Egg yolk|egg yolk]].
# [[Cookbook:Baking|Bake]] in a preheated [[Cookbook:Oven|oven]] at a low heat (212–338°F / 100–170°C) until they begin to emit vapors. Then, remove from the oven.<ref>{{cite book |author=Yosef Qafih|title=Halichot Teman (Jewish Life in Sanà) |publisher=Ben-Zvi Institute |edition= |date=1982 |location=Jerusalem |page=208 |language=Hebrew |isbn=965-17-0137-4 |oclc=863513860 }}</ref>
